key_insight: OrbitForge turns a single text-generated video into a more reliable 3D Gaussian Splatting scene by using reconstruction to anchor and complete a closed camera orbit.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a practical text-to-3D pipeline that improves view coverage and consistency without task-specific fine-tuning, score distillation, or stepwise view generation.
method: Generate an initial video from frozen text-to-video priors.
Reconstruct a preliminary 3D scene with Deformable Gaussian Splatting using a robust MedianGS proxy.
Render a prescribed orbit, identify missing viewpoints, complete them with the video model, and reconstruct the full orbit into the final scene.
evidence_signal: On a frozen 300-prompt T3Bench-derived audit, OrbitForge reached a 359.0-degree median span and improved unsupported-bin Q10 ImageReward from 8.07 to 16.36 over MedianGS-only reconstruction.
watch_item: The approach depends on accurate missing-view detection and the quality of the underlying frozen video prior, so failures in either can limit reconstruction fidelity.
paper_title: OrbitForge: Text-to-3D Scene Generation via Reconstruction-Anchored Video Synthesis
